a2ui.verdict: UNVERIFIED — the model did not emit an A2UI artifact this run
a2ui.whyConditional: A 4B local model is nondeterministic about emitting an A2UI artifact — measured in this suite, the same prompt produced 1 tool call on one run and 0 on the next. Demanding one would make this gate flaky, and a flaky gate teaches people to ignore failures.

markersInShippedSo: not available on the embedded runtime
build.webFetchAbsentOnMobile: web_fetch and its SSRF guard are NOT in the mobile .so, and that is correct: the tool registers only when web_fetch_enabled is set, which mobile never does. Shipping the guard to a phone that cannot reach the tool would be dead weight.

harnessBugFixedThisRun: The first version of the resource-control assertion matched labels exactly and returned [] against a WORKING build: the controls render their resolved selection, so the accessible name is 'Tools inherit', not 'Tools'. Now prefix-matched. An exact-match check would have reported a missing capability that was present.

offline.method: svc wifi disable + svc data disable, then a reachability probe
offline.why: svc wifi disable ALONE does not take this device offline: measured with wifi_on=0, ping 8.8.8.8 returned 0% packet loss over mobile data, so a flag-only gate would certify nothing.

resourceControls.claim: Skills/Tools/Knowledge are reachable with no network. `tools` in particular was a hardcoded [] before S6 and is now served from the native + MCP registries in-process.

seededAgents.claim: the built-in agents are present and selectable with NO network
seededAgents.notAcceptedAsProof: the agent-context control alone — it renders whether or not any agent was seeded, so passing on it would certify nothing

whatThisRunProvesBeyondTheLast: `tools` was a hardcoded [] on the embedded branch and advertised as unavailable until S6. resourceControls.visible now shows Skills and Tools reachable with both radios down, so this run measures the new work rather than repeating the previous PASS.
